aggregators.name: AGG_AVERAGE
aggregators.description: Arithmetic mean of the field across the input set.

aggregators.name: AGG_COUNT
aggregators.description: Count records that pass the active filter, optionally by group.

aggregators.name: AGG_DISTINCT_COUNT
aggregators.description: Count of distinct non-null values across the input set.

aggregators.name: AGG_FREQUENCY
aggregators.description: Per-distinct-value count of the field (returned as map in Details).

aggregators.name: AGG_GEO_BBOX
aggregators.description: Bounding box (min/max lat/lon) of point_f64 values.

aggregators.name: AGG_GEO_CENTROID
aggregators.description: Spherical centroid (lat, lon) of point_f64 values.

aggregators.name: AGG_KURTOSIS
aggregators.description: Bias-corrected excess kurtosis via online moments.

aggregators.name: AGG_MAX
aggregators.description: Largest non-null value of the field.

aggregators.name: AGG_MEDIAN
aggregators.description: 50th percentile of the field; requires sorting the full value set.
aggregators.streamable_hint: Use AGG_AVERAGE for a streaming central-tendency proxy, or accept the buffered path.

aggregators.name: AGG_MIN
aggregators.description: Smallest non-null value of the field.

aggregators.name: AGG_MODE
aggregators.description: Most-frequent value of the field (ties broken by first-seen order).
aggregators.emits_type_note: string (echoes the dictionary value or stringified scalar)

aggregators.name: AGG_PERCENTILE
aggregators.description: Configurable percentile of the field; requires sorting the full value set.

params.name: percentile
params.description: Percentile to compute, in [0, 100]. e.g. 95 for p95.

aggregators.streamable_hint: Use AGG_AVERAGE or accept the buffered path; exact percentiles need sorted input.

aggregators.name: AGG_RANGE
aggregators.description: Spread (max minus min) of the field across the input set.

aggregators.name: AGG_STDDEV
aggregators.description: Population standard deviation via Welford's online algorithm.

aggregators.name: AGG_SUM
aggregators.description: Sum the numeric values of the field across the input set.
aggregators.emits_type_note: scalar float64 (decimal128 preserved when input is decimal)

aggregators.name: AGG_VARIANCE
aggregators.description: Population variance via Welford's online algorithm.

aggregators.name: AGG_ZSCORE
aggregators.streamable_hint: Streaming uses online Welford moments; the ZSCORE aggregate finalize step needs the full deviation sum.

attributes.name: ATTR_DATE_PART
attributes.description: Extract a calendar component (year, month, day, year_month, year_month_day, month_day) from a date field.

params.name: part
params.description: Which calendar component to extract.

attributes.name: ATTR_FORMULA
attributes.description: Per-row expression evaluation against the record's fields (e.g. "price * qty").
attributes.emits_type_note: one float per record (booleans coerce to 0/1)

attributes.name: ATTR_PERCENTILE
attributes.description: Per-row percentile rank against the post-filter value set; requires sorting.
attributes.streamable_hint: Use ATTR_NORMALIZED for a streaming-friendly rank proxy.

attributes.name: ATTR_TSCORE
attributes.description: Per-row T-score: z-score scaled and shifted to mean 50, stddev 10.

attributes.name: ATTR_ZSCORE
attributes.description: Per-row standardized z-score: (value − mean) / stddev computed via Welford two-pass streaming.
attributes.emits_type_note: one float per record (NaN when stddev=0)

filterers.name: FILTER_EXCLUDE
filterers.description: Drop records whose field value appears in the supplied Values list.

filterers.name: FILTER_EXPRESSION
filterers.description: Keep records for which Expression evaluates truthy; reads any record field.

filterers.name: FILTER_GEO_WITHIN
filterers.description: Keep point_f64 records that lie inside the supplied polygon (Values lists vertices).

filterers.name: FILTER_GEO_WITHIN_RADIUS_M
filterers.description: Keep point_f64 records within radius (m) of a reference point; Values=[lat, lon, radius_m].

filterers.name: FILTER_INCLUDE
filterers.description: Keep records whose field value appears in the supplied Values list.

filterers.name: FILTER_RANGE
filterers.description: Keep records whose numeric field value falls within [low, high]; Values=[low, high].

groupers.name: GROUP_CATEGORY
groupers.description: Partition records by exact field value; ideal for categorical fields.

groupers.name: GROUP_DATE
groupers.description: Partition date-typed records by a calendar component (year, quarter, month, week, day, day_of_week).

params.name: component
params.description: Calendar component to bucket by.

groupers.streamable_hint: Use GROUP_CATEGORY on an ATTR_DATE_PART output column for a streaming-friendly substitute.

groupers.name: GROUP_H3_CELL
groupers.description: Group spatial records by H3 cell at the configured resolution; accepts point_f64 (converts inline) or h3_cell (re-bins via parent walk).

params.name: resolution
params.description: Target H3 resolution in [0, 15]; finer resolutions bucket more aggressively.

groupers.emits_type_note: string H3 cell index per row

groupers.name: GROUP_QUANTILE
groupers.description: Partition records into N equal-population quantile buckets (Q1..Q4 / D1..D10 / P1..P100).

params.name: interval
params.description: Number of buckets. Conventional values 4 (quartiles), 10 (deciles), 100 (percentiles); set on the request's Group.Interval field, not in Params.

groupers.emits_type_note: bucket label per row (Qk / Dk / Pk)
groupers.streamable_hint: Quantile cutoffs need the sorted value set; use GROUP_RANGE or GROUP_ROUNDED with known bounds for streaming.

groupers.name: GROUP_RANGE
groupers.description: Partition numeric records into half-open ranges [a, b); Interval controls the bucket width.

params.name: interval
params.description: Bucket width on the value axis; set on the request's Group.Interval field.

groupers.name: GROUP_ROUNDED
groupers.description: Round each numeric value to the nearest multiple of Interval and group by the rounded scalar.

params.name: interval
params.description: Rounding increment; set on the request's Group.Interval field.

windows.name: WIN_DENSE_RANK
windows.description: Dense rank with no gaps after ties (1, 2, 2, 3, …) within the ordered partition.

windows.name: WIN_EWMA
windows.description: Exponentially weighted moving average; current = α·value + (1−α)·previous.

params.name: alpha
params.description: Smoothing factor in (0, 1]; higher values weight recent observations more.

windows.name: WIN_LAG
windows.description: Return the value of Field from the row N positions before the current row in the ordered partition.

params.name: offset
params.description: Lookback offset (≥ 1).

params.name: default
params.description: Substitute value when the lookback row does not exist.

windows.emits_type_note: one float per row (Default when offset crosses partition start)

windows.name: WIN_LEAD
windows.description: Return the value of Field from the row N positions after the current row in the ordered partition.

params.name: offset
params.description: Lookahead offset (≥ 1).

params.name: default
params.description: Substitute value when the lookahead row does not exist.

windows.name: WIN_MOVING_AVG
windows.description: Moving average of Field over the configured Frame; Frame width must be bounded.
windows.emits_type_note: one float per row (NaN when frame is empty)

windows.name: WIN_PCT_CHANGE
windows.description: Percent change relative to the row Periods positions earlier in the ordered partition.

params.name: periods
params.description: Lookback offset (≥ 1) for the comparison row.

windows.emits_type_note: one float per row (NaN when previous value is zero or missing)

windows.name: WIN_RANK
windows.description: Sparse rank with gaps after ties (1, 2, 2, 4, …) within the ordered partition.

windows.name: WIN_ROW_NUMBER
windows.description: 1-based row index within the ordered partition.
windows.emits_type_note: one integer per row (resets per partition)

windows.name: WIN_RUNNING_AVG
windows.description: Running average of Field over the configured Frame within the ordered partition.

windows.name: WIN_RUNNING_SUM
windows.description: Running total of Field over the configured Frame within the ordered partition.

features.name: FEAT_BUCKETIZE
features.description: Bin a numeric column into ordered buckets using explicit boundaries or N equal-population quantiles.

params.name: boundaries
params.description: Sorted ascending list of bucket cutpoints (mutually exclusive with quantiles).

params.name: quantiles
params.description: Number of equal-population buckets (mutually exclusive with boundaries).

features.emits_type_note: single column "<label>" with bucket index per row

features.name: FEAT_DATE_FEATURES
features.description: Expand a date field into year, month, day, day_of_week, and is_weekend columns.

features.name: FEAT_FREQUENCY_ENCODE
features.description: Replace each categorical value with its observed relative frequency in the cohort.
features.emits_type_note: single column "<label>" with frequency per row

features.name: FEAT_LOG
features.description: Per-row natural log of Field; emits one f64 column.

features.name: FEAT_ONE_HOT
features.description: One-hot encode a categorical field as one f32 column per dictionary entry.
features.emits_type_note: one column per dictionary entry, prefixed by label

features.name: FEAT_SQRT
features.description: Per-row square root of Field; emits one f64 column.

features.name: FEAT_TARGET_ENCODE
features.description: Replace each categorical value with the smoothed mean of a numeric Target field for that category.

params.name: target
params.description: Numeric field whose grouped mean is encoded into the output column.

params.name: smoothing
params.description: Bayesian smoothing weight blending category mean with global mean.

features.emits_type_note: single column "<label>"; risk of target leakage on non-CV pipelines

features.name: FEAT_TRAIN_TEST_SPLIT
features.description: Emit a deterministic split assignment column (0=train, 1=val, 2=test) for ML workflows.

params.name: ratios
params.description: Two- or three-element ratio list summing to ~1.0.

params.name: seed
params.description: RNG seed; same seed produces byte-identical assignments.

params.name: stratify
params.description: Optional categorical field; ratios are applied per category for class balance.

features.emits_type_note: single column "<label>" with split assignment per row

error_codes.description: A CLI command failed to dispatch or returned a non-zero status.
fixups: Check the wrapped error in the envelope details; for processing leaves, run pulse predict --json on the request first.

error_codes.description: A CLI argument or flag is malformed (missing value, unknown subcommand, bad JSON).
fixups: Re-run with --help on the subcommand to confirm flag names and required values.

error_codes.description: Internal invariant violated inside the CLI binary; report with reproducer.
Output generation failed (file write error, terminal too narrow, format unsupported).
fixups: Pick a writable output path with free disk space, or omit --output to stream to stdout.

error_codes.description: A calculation over data values failed (e.g., reading a field that does not exist on the record).
fixups: Verify every field reference in the request appears in pulse inspect --json output for the cohort.

error_codes.description: An I/O job's configuration is invalid (conflicting flags, unknown format, bad target path).
fixups: Re-run with --help; check that the format flag matches the file extension and the schema template names existing columns.

error_codes.description: A data file could not be opened or its layout is invalid.
fixups: Verify the input file exists, is non-empty, and matches the declared format (CSV / TSV / NDJSON / Parquet / Excel).

error_codes.description: Internal invariant violated inside the data layer; report with reproducer.
Tabular input (CSV / TSV / JSON / Parquet) failed to parse at a row boundary.
fixups: Inspect the offending row with pulse sample --rows N; common causes are inconsistent column counts, stray quotes, or wrong delimiter.

error_codes.description: Internal invariant violated inside the encoding layer; report with reproducer.
The .pulse file header or schema block is malformed (bad magic, unsupported format version, or invalid field-type byte).
fixups: Re-import the source data to regenerate the .pulse file; the existing file is corrupt or was written by an incompatible binary.

error_codes.description: An I/O failure occurred while reading or writing the binary .pulse file.
fixups: Verify the file path is reachable, the process has read/write permission, and the underlying filesystem has free space.

error_codes.description: A value cannot be encoded into its declared field type (out of range, wrong sign, or wrong unit).
fixups: Widen the field type (u8 -> u16, f32 -> f64) or pre-clean the source data to fit the declared type, then re-import.

error_codes.description: An operator's configuration is invalid (missing params, wrong type, out-of-range value).
fixups: Run pulse predict --json on the request first; the predict envelope names the offending operator and parameter so the fix is mechanical.

error_codes.description: Group construction failed (e.g., quantile with zero-variance input, malformed bucket key).
fixups: Swap GROUP_QUANTILE for GROUP_RANGE on near-constant fields, or GROUP_CATEGORY for a high-cardinality numeric to GROUP_ROUNDED.

error_codes.description: Internal invariant violated inside the processing layer; report with reproducer.
An operator failed during row processing (formula compile failure, divide-by-zero, etc.).
fixups: Guard the formula with a null/zero check (e.g. wrap denominators in an iff(x == 0, null, x) before dividing).
Add a FILTER_RANGE that excludes the rows that trip the runtime error before the operator runs.

error_codes.description: Pipeline state-machine invariant violated mid-run (typically a streaming-pass ordering bug).
A numeric aggregation (SUM, AVERAGE, etc.) was requested on a categorical field.
fixups: Use AGG_MODE, AGG_FREQUENCY, AGG_DISTINCT_COUNT, or AGG_COUNT for categorical fields.
If the numeric semantics matter, pick a non-categorical numeric field on the same cohort.

error_codes.description: An aggregation has no defined semantics for the decimal128 field type (e.g., AGG_MEDIAN, AGG_PERCENTILE in v1).
fixups: Decimal fields support exact AGG_SUM, AGG_AVERAGE, AGG_MIN, AGG_MAX, AGG_VARIANCE, AGG_STDDEV, AGG_COUNT, AGG_DISTINCT_COUNT; pick one of those.

error_codes.description: A numeric aggregator was requested on a geospatial field (point_f64 / h3_cell).
fixups: Geo fields support AGG_GEO_CENTROID, AGG_GEO_BBOX, AGG_COUNT, AGG_DISTINCT_COUNT; pick one of those, or group by the cell and aggregate a numeric field.

error_codes.description: A decimal divide operation observed a zero divisor.
fixups: Pre-filter zero divisors with FILTER_RANGE (min > 0 or max < 0) or guard the formula with an explicit non-zero check.

error_codes.description: A decimal arithmetic result exceeds the decimal128(38) representable range.
fixups: Use AGG_AVERAGE instead of AGG_SUM for large series; the implementation falls back to f64 and emits PULSE_DECIMAL_PRECISION_LOSS instead of failing.
Pick a coarser decimal scale or split the cohort so each partial sum stays within 38 digits.

error_codes.description: A decimal aggregation fell back to f64 because intermediate state would have overflowed decimal128(38).
fixups: Split the cohort or pre-aggregate by a coarser grouping so each partial sum fits in 38 digits; ignore the warning if auditor-grade precision is not required.

error_codes.description: A row could not be exported due to a per-cell value-to-string conversion failure.
fixups: Re-import the source data to regenerate the .pulse file; the dictionary or encoding state is inconsistent.

error_codes.description: FEAT_TARGET_ENCODE was requested without a prior FEAT_TRAIN_TEST_SPLIT; encoded values include rows that should be held out.
fixups: Insert a FEAT_TRAIN_TEST_SPLIT operator before every FEAT_TARGET_ENCODE in the features list.

error_codes.description: A field description is empty, too short, or matches a generic-word denylist ("n/a", "tbd", etc.).
fixups: Provide a sentence (>= 10 characters) describing what the field represents, including units and domain meaning.

error_codes.description: An AGG_GEO_BBOX input crosses the 180/-180 meridian, where a flat min/max bbox is ambiguous.
fixups: Use AGG_GEO_CENTROID (the 3D unit-sphere algorithm handles antimeridian crossings) or split the cohort by hemisphere with FILTER_RANGE on longitude.

error_codes.description: A point parse failed or |lat|>90 / |lon|>180.
fixups: Re-import with the latitude and longitude columns mapped in the correct order; WKT writes POINT(lon lat) but Pulse stores (lat, lon).

error_codes.description: A WKT POLYGON parse failed or the outer ring is not closed.
fixups: Supply a single closed outer ring with first vertex equal to last; v1 rejects MULTIPOLYGON and inner-ring holes.

error_codes.description: An H3 resolution is out of [0, 15] or finer than a cell's native resolution when walking parents.
fixups: Pick a resolution in [0, 15]; for h3_cell input, pick at most the cell's native resolution (parent walks only go coarser).

error_codes.description: A categorical column's observed dictionary exceeded the declared width capacity (u8 / u16 / u32).
fixups: Widen the categorical type (categorical_u8 -> categorical_u16, categorical_u16 -> categorical_u32) and re-import.

error_codes.description: The categorical inference heuristic believes the column has unbounded cardinality and should be modeled as a string.
fixups: Re-import with the column declared as a non-categorical type; if cardinality is truly bounded, raise --sample-rows to confirm.

error_codes.description: A field description exceeds the 1000-byte cap defined for the .pulse header.
fixups: Trim the description to <= 1000 bytes; keep what the field represents, drop the prose narrative.

error_codes.description: A row could not be imported due to a per-cell encoding or parse failure.
fixups: Inspect the reported row index in details; pick a wider or nullable field type, or pre-clean the source value before re-importing.

error_codes.description: Schema inference observed conflicting types in the same column across the sample window.
fixups: Increase --sample-rows so the inference window sees a representative subset, or supply --schema with an explicit type for the offending column.

error_codes.description: The profile layer cannot summarize this field type (e.g., point_f64 / h3_cell); the field is skipped.
fixups: Synthesize the affected field from an explicit schema spec instead of relying on profile-driven mode.

error_codes.description: Rejection sampling for declared constraints exceeded the allowed rejection rate; the generator gives up rather than produce biased output.
fixups: Relax the constraint, switch to a distribution that concentrates inside the constraint region, or raise max_rejection_rate if you accept the cost.

error_codes.description: A synth spec referenced a distribution kind not registered in the synth package.
fixups: Check the distribution name against synth.AllDistributions(); common typos: gaussian -> normal, power_law -> pareto.

error_codes.description: A repeated-measures test observed unequal cell counts; only balanced designs are supported in v1.
fixups: Filter or pre-aggregate so each subject contributes exactly one observation per condition before running TEST_ANOVA_RM.

error_codes.description: A chi-square contingency table is empty or has a single row/column.
fixups: Verify both Rows and Cols resolve to fields with more than one observed level; aggregate rare levels into an "other" bucket if needed.

error_codes.description: Pearson r encountered a column with zero variance; r and its t-statistic are undefined.
fixups: Pearson r is undefined when either variable is constant; use TEST_SPEARMAN_R or TEST_KENDALL_TAU for monotonic association on near-constant data, or remove the constant column.

error_codes.description: A chi-square cell's expected count is below 5; the asymptotic χ² approximation is unreliable.
fixups: Use TEST_FISHER_EXACT for small 2x2 tables; for larger tables, pool rare levels to raise per-cell expected counts.

error_codes.description: Field2 for a paired or bivariate test (PEARSON_R, PAIRED_T) resolves to a non-numeric schema type.
fixups: Pick a numeric field (u*, f*, nullable_u*, decimal128), or cast the column via ATTR_FORMULA before running the test.

error_codes.description: A test requires a numeric field but the named field resolves to a categorical, geo, or otherwise non-numeric schema type.
fixups: Pick a numeric field (u*, f*, nullable_u*, decimal128) or use TEST_CHISQ with Rows/Cols for categorical association.

error_codes.description: Fisher exact requires a 2×2 table; r×c support lands separately.
fixups: Use TEST_CHISQ for rxc tables when expected counts are large enough; or filter the cohort to a 2x2 subset with FILTER_INCLUDE.

error_codes.description: A test received fewer non-null observations than the minimum needed to compute its statistic.
fixups: Widen upstream filters so >= 30 non-null rows remain per group, or pick a test that tolerates small samples (Fisher exact for 2x2 instead of chi-square).

error_codes.description: The request's Alpha value lies outside (0, 1).
fixups: Pick a value in (0, 1); common choices are 0.10, 0.05, 0.01. Omit Alpha to accept the 0.05 default.

error_codes.description: A paired test encountered rows with one of the paired columns null while the other is present; drop-pair semantics applied.
fixups: Pre-filter rows where either paired column is null with FILTER_EXCLUDE so the effective pair count is explicit; or ignore the warning if the mismatch count is small.

error_codes.description: A Shapiro-Wilk request observed n above the supported limit (5000); use an asymptotic normality test instead.
fixups: Sample <= 5000 rows before running TEST_SHAPIRO_WILK, or use an asymptotic normality test (Anderson-Darling, D'Agostino K2) when registered.

error_codes.description: A two-sample or ANOVA test observed fewer than the required number of distinct groups in the SplitBy field.
fixups: Pick a SplitBy field that resolves to >= 2 distinct categories after filtering, or relax upstream filters.

error_codes.description: A repeated-measures test found at least one subject missing one or more conditions; incomplete subjects dropped by default.
fixups: Pre-filter the cohort to retain only fully observed subjects, or ignore the warning if the dropped count is small relative to N.

error_codes.description: TEST_PROP_Z did not supply Params.success; the test cannot decide which category counts as a positive outcome.
fixups: Supply the dictionary value that represents success (e.g. {"success": "yes"}); use pulse inspect to list the categorical's dictionary values.

error_codes.description: A rank-based test observed ties on ≥ 50 % of input values; the asymptotic approximation loses accuracy.
fixups: Treat the p-value as advisory; for small n with heavy ties prefer an exact-permutation variant when registered, or accept the effect-direction statistic alone.

error_codes.description: Tukey HSD requires k ≥ 3 groups; a t-test or two-proportion z is the appropriate alternative for k = 2.
fixups: Swap TEST_TUKEY_HSD for TEST_T or TEST_WELCH (continuous) or TEST_PROP_Z (proportions) when only two groups are present.

error_codes.description: The request referenced a TestType not registered in either the row-test or post-test registry.
fixups: Check the test name against types.AllTestTypes(); confirm the test is registered for the intended tier (Tests vs PostTests).

error_codes.description: One or more groups have zero sample variance, making the t- or F-statistic undefined.
fixups: Field is constant in the affected group; pick a different field or use TEST_KS for distribution comparison on near-constant data.

error_codes.description: A window operator's configuration is invalid (bad frame, alpha out of bounds, no order key, label collision).
fixups: Every WIN_* operator requires at least one OrderBy key; supply a date or numeric field.
Drop Frame for ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LAG, LEAD, PCT_CHANGE; supply Frame with bounded preceding/following for MOVING_AVG, EWMA, RUNNING_*.

error_codes.description: Internal invariant violated inside the service orchestration layer; report with reproducer.
The request named an operator that is not registered (typo in type field, deprecated identifier).
fixups: Check the operator name against pulse manifest --json (Components section); spelling and casing must match exactly.

error_codes.description: A required resource could not be opened (missing .pulse file, unreadable path).
fixups: Verify the cohort filename exists under PULSE_DATA_DIR (or the configured DataDir) and the process has read access.

error_codes.description: The request failed pre-execution validation (missing required fields, invalid combinations, schema mismatch).
fixups: Call pulse predict --json on the request; predict reports the exact missing or malformed field path so the fix is mechanical.

mcp_tools.name: pulse_manifest
mcp_tools.description: Return the root Pulse manifest — the LLM-authored-request bootstrap blob. Carries per-operator params + accepted field types + streamability, tier-1 + tier-2 test catalogs as peer slices, synth distributions, error codes, MCP tool list, and cohort field types with operator cross-references. MCP always returns the slim payload (no prose descriptions); fetch operator prose via pulse_skills_get when needed.
